| 7:30–7:35 | Cool-down: 5 min static stretching (hamstrings, quads, hip flexors) |

| Time | Focus |
|------|-------|
| 7:00–7:15 | Interval sprints (your existing 6×400 m) |

| 7:20–7:30 | **Transition shooting** — simulate counterattack: sprint 20 m with ball, receive a "pass" (use a wall or rebounder), shoot on the move. 8–10 reps, alternating feet. Emphasize first-touch control before shooting. |
| 7:30–7:35 | Cool-down + 25 min stretching (your existing routine) |

**Duration: 45–50 min**
| Time | Focus |
|------|-------|
| 10:00–10:10 | Full dynamic warm-up: jog, leg swings, lunges, ball juggling, core activation |
| 10:10–10:20 | **Stationary accuracy** — 25 shots from 10–15 m, low-driven, target the corners. Alternate feet (right 15, left 10). |

| 10:30–10:38 | **Game simulation** — 10 shots: receive a pass, one touch to set up, shoot. Mix of right and left. Include 3–4 shots under "pressure" (set a cone as a defender to step around). |
| 10:38–10:45 | **Power + accuracy combo** — 5 shots each foot: aim for a specific small target (e.g., a marked square in the corner). |
| 10:45–10:50 | Cool-down: 5 min jog + 10 min static stretching |

**Journal note:** Total shots, on target, in goal, left-foot %, power rating (1–5), any notes on technique.

---

Each week, log:
- Total shots taken (target: ~100–120/week across all sessions)
- On-target rate (aim to trend upward)
- Left-foot on-target % (this is your growth metric)

| Week | Adjustment |
|------|-----------|
| 1–2 | Baseline. Focus on form, not volume. |
| 3–4 | Add 5 shots per session. Introduce a moving target on Monday. |
| 5–6 | Add 2–3 shots under time pressure (shoot within 2 seconds of receiving). |
| 7–8 | Increase distance by 2 m on angle shots. Add 3 shots from 18–20 m. |

## A few notes specific to you

- **Left-foot is the priority.** Scott flagged it, and your right foot is already solid. The 10 left-foot shots in the Sunday session and the dedicated Monday block are where the real gain will come from.
- **Low-driven, every time.** Coach Mehmet's advice. It's harder to save, more predictable for you, and suits a midfielder shooting from angles.
